description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Resource_Extends class, which implements a resource type for the Smarty template engine to support extending multiple template files in a chain. It includes methods for populating template source metadata, loading content, and managing timestamps.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Extends
classes.description: Implements the resource type for Smarty templates that extend a chain of template files, providing methods to populate metadata, load content, and handle timestamps for such resources.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Fills the source object with metadata from component templates, including filepath, UID, and existence status.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp and existence status of the source object based on its components.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the combined content of all component templates into the source object.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns the basename for the resource's compiled filename based on the filepath.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Indicates whether timestamp validation is required; returns false to disable it for this resource.
